name: J. D. Sumner
description: '''John Daniel Sumner''' (November 19, 1924 – November 16, 1998) was an American gospel singer, songwriter, and music promoter noted for his [[bass (voice type)|bass voice]], and his innovation in the Christian and Gospel music fields. Sumner sang in five quartets and was a member of [[the Blackwood Brothers]] during their 1950s heyday. Aside from his incredibly low bass voice, Sumner's [[business acumen]] helped promote Southern Gospel and move it into the mainstream of American culture and music during the 1950s and 1960s.
